title: Air Force cooperation with Stargate

tellings.quote: In fact, two sitting Air Force Chiefs of Staff, Michael E. Ryan and John P. Jumper appeared on the show as themselves.

plain: Michels says the US Air Force worked closely with the science-fiction television series Stargate SG-1, which starred Richard Dean Anderson and began in 1997. As proof, he points out that two serving Air Force Chiefs of Staff, Michael E. Ryan and John P. Jumper, "appeared on the show as themselves." He raises it himself, without naming a source, as a sign that the military may have wanted to shape how the public thinks about secret space programs.
